Goblin Scrapper (CV 8)

A small, wiry goblin salvager with keen eyes, patched work clothes and pockets full of useful scraps. Quick hands and knowledge of the ruins compensate for modest reach.

Attributes: Brawn +0; Fortitude +0; Agility +2; Guile +1; Knowledge +0; Reason +0

HP: 8 · Speed: 7 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 0

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: None · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: None\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Scrap knife

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Slip the Rush

As the pursuer lunges into reach, it ducks sideways through the space the rush left open.

After a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to this creature, move up to 1 square without provoking from that enemy. Other opportunity attacks and normal terrain costs apply. This movement grants no attack; it cannot trigger from forced movement or movement granted by a free attack.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Roll Away: Normal terrain costs and occupied-square restrictions apply.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Bright scraps are tied to trip-free routes through the rubble.

Purpose: Protect a salvage claim and avoid being cheated.

Tactics and retreat: Roll Away between cover and a distracted opponent; bargain when cornered.

Counterplay and conversation: Recognize the salvage claim or trade a useful tool.

Habitat: Ruin; roadside · Communication: Common and Goblin

Loot: Melee weapon, tool scraps and 3 coins.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

Reference damage: 2/3/5

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.2

Action review (#1279): U 1.1 → 1.2: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=4.404, O=2.162. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
